changes.before: Companion / identical enacted high energy use facility site-assessment bill; incorporated SB130.
changes.after: Published chapter/code site-assessment framework requires an applicant's sound assessment before specified local approvals for a new facility reasonably anticipated to require at least 100 MW of retail utility power. Sound impacts concern homes and schools within 500 feet of the facility property boundary; other resource assessments are optional, and utility substation/voltage information is also required subject to stated qualifications. The framework preserves the existing-approval/expansion exception; its phrase “does not exceed an additional 100 megawatts or more” is not converted into a definitive boundary here. The chapter labels the provision 15.2-2209.4; the observed code publishes it as 15.2-2209.5. Later force is not independently confirmed.
